# Balancing Nutrients in Vertical Systems

Anwen Quenstead: Welcome back to The Umbdra Review. Today, we’re diving into nutrient optimization for stacked grow towers with Rhosyn Kesphollow from Verdant Sky Farms. Rhosyn, thanks for joining us.

Rhosyn Kesphollow: Thanks, Anwen. Glad to be here.

Anwen: So, nutrient dosing in vertical systems — what’s the biggest challenge you face?

Rhosyn: It’s maintaining balance across multiple layers. For example, we had a batch of basil where the lower tiers were showing magnesium deficiencies while the upper tiers looked fine. Turns out, the nutrient solution was getting diluted unevenly due to flow rate variations.

Anwen: Interesting. How did you fix that?

Rhosyn: We installed real-time sensors at three heights and adjusted dosing pumps accordingly. That reduced magnesium issues by 60% in two months.

Anwen: That’s impressive. Any surprises from yield forecasting when you started tuning nutrients?

Rhosyn: Definitely. We saw yield predictability improve by about 25%, especially for leafy greens. Nutrient consistency really tightens the model accuracy.

Anwen: Great insights, Rhosyn. Thanks for sharing these stories with us today.

Rhosyn: My pleasure, Anwen.
